newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven youths gunned down near Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Seven youths gunned down near Colombian capital.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot and killed seven youths in a working class district on the northwest outskirts of the Colombian capital, authorities said on Sunday.

Police quoted witnesses as saying the victims, all men between the ages of 18 and 20, were gathered late on Saturday night outside a supermarket in the Chia district when three well- dressed men pulled up in a late model Toyota jeep and sprayed them with automatic gunfire.
District police chief Col. Alonso Arango Salazar said there were no immediate clues as to who was responsible for the killing.

But local news reports said it appeared to be the work of right-wing gunmen conducting a so-called campaign of "social cleansing" in Chia aimed at clearing it of criminals, beggars and suspected sympathisers of Colombia's leftist guerrilla groups.
